item.title: CVE-2026-115232 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | In iceoryx2 versions from 0.6.0 to 0.10.0, The C API getters that copy a service's hash into a caller-provided buffer (e.g. iox2_port_factory_pub_sub_service_hash and its other messaging protocol counterparts) write one byte past the end of the caller's buffer when `buffer_len` is less or equal to 40. The out-of-bounds byte is the string's NUL terminator, written at `buffer[buffer_len]`.
Resolution:
Resolution
The bugfix is released with iceoryx2 version 0.10.1 and on main branch (commit 7ca14dd).
Please note that the language bindings for C/C++ and Python (including the iceoryx2-ffi-c crate) are not published to crates.io since they are a local development dependency.

item.title: CVE-2026-93584 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.6 | An SQL injection vulnerability in OTRS versions 2024.3.1 through 2026.8.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL expressions through the Survey endpoint.
The vulnerability exists in the Kernel::System::Survey::Request::RequestGet() method, which directly incorporates an attacker-controlled survey key into a SQL query without using parameterized statements. Successful exploitation allows attackers to retrieve ticket information and perform boolean-based or time-based blind SQL injection to extract potentially sensitive data accessible to the OTRS database account. Exploitation does not require authentication, a valid survey key, or an existing survey request. The external frontend must be accessible.
